title: Psionic HexCasting
description: A resourcepack for HexCasting themed around PSI
body:
![A preview of what the pack offers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/440b10f7416ae389e42f154b098f9ab4514d8e3a.png)
A resourcepack that aims to retexture/remodel some items from HexCasting. It was made mostly for personal use and out of love to the two mods, inspired by [Magical Psi](https://modrinth.com/mod/magical-psi-revival)'s concept, except flipped on it's head :D

Things the pack replaces:
- Abacus
- Mindsplice Staff
- Jeweler's Hammer
- Phials

Note: items listed below have their variants modified, accessible through the caster's glamour spell
(variant indexes counted from 0)
- Cypher (variant 2)
- Ancient cypher (variant 2)
- Trinket (variant 2)
- Artifact (variant 2)
- Focus (variant 2)
- Spellbook (variant 3)
